text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A dress for the reception... Which one should I choose? I suppose I'll try them on and compare.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I've been going to so many parties lately,
I've ended up eating all sorts of things...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, starting today,
I want to double my training menu.
choice_data_list: Why?! That's overworking, so absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Guh... But I can't let everyone see me looking so lax...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Duramente-kun,
I have something that's just perfect for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's a diet supplement I developed. It enhances energy consumption during aerobic exercise, doubling the workout's effectiveness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're willing to assist with my experiment...
I'll give you this supplement. What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! Tachyon! Your supplement is marvelous!
A dress that previously wouldn't zip up
now fits me perfectly.
choice_data_list: You really managed to lose the weight?!
You really managed to lose the weight?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, even though the main ingredient is just 'water.'
Heheh... to think a mere placebo effect
could produce numbers like this."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Man, Duramente-kun's potential is
simply marvelous!
